summary: Updated SentinelFlow specification and implementation plan tailored as a bank-side security and fraud triage workbench to detect and prevent Digital Arrest scams, Fake VIP Trading/IPO scams, and Remote-Access Elderly Financial Exploitation across major Indian & APAC banks (HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank, Indian Overseas Bank, SBI, DBS). Preserves SentinelFlow's deterministic correlation rules, schema-bound Gemini incident briefs, code-level EVT-ID output validation, full Google Cloud stack integration, and adds an Empathetic Elderly Intervention & Funds-Saved workflow.
